# Secure CI/CD foundations

## Protect the pipeline

- Require reviewed changes and protect release branches.
- Use short-lived, least-privilege credentials where supported.
- Keep secrets out of source code, logs, artifacts, and build arguments.
- Pin and review third-party actions, plugins, and dependencies.

## Add security checks

Run secret detection, dependency checks, static analysis, and container/image scanning as part of the workflow. Set clear ownership for findings and avoid treating a passing scanner as proof that software is secure.

## Release safely

Build once and promote the same immutable artifact between environments. Record provenance, restrict production deployment permissions, and keep a tested rollback path.
